_comment: Coverage ratchet baseline (scripts/coverage_report.py --check). union_binding_*, cells_live and template_cell_liveness_bp may not DECREASE; dead_cells and never_evaluated_rules may not INCREASE. Update only after a deliberate, recorded improvement — never to clear a red gate. READ THIS BEFORE TRUSTING A GREEN: cells_live is the cell-coverage floor. template_cell_liveness_bp is a RATIO whose denominator shrinks with its numerator and dead_cells is declared-minus-live, so both can IMPROVE while coverage is destroyed — measured, deleting the b31/rich run loses 689 live cells while moving liveness 1285->1374bp and dead 55553->47123. Only cells_live and the binding-rule counts fail on that. Separately, every metric is a UNION over the portfolio x regime matrix recorded in provenance, so growing RUNS makes dead_cells RISE and template_cell_liveness_bp FALL by declaring cells no portfolio fills yet; on a matrix change --check reports the comparison as INVALID rather than as a regression, and the right response is to re-measure and bank the new matrix with the reason in _note — never to drop a portfolio so the old numbers fit again.
_note: Re-banked 2026-11-14 (eighth time), when master was merged into the filing-package branch: the Basel 3.1 template-level extract is now master's BoE taxonomy v4.1.1 (basel31-boe-v4.1.1-credit-risk.json, 816 rules / 800 enforced), moved into rwa-filer's package data. union_binding_rules_b31 397 -> 390 and never_evaluated_rules 687 -> 686; nothing else moved, and CRR did not move. Measured rule by rule (every per-run outcome dumped on both trees): 11 rules stopped binding - boe_b0303, b0744, b0745 and b0752_22 / 23 / 24 withdrawn by the Bank; b0756, b0757, b0758 no longer enforced in XBRL; b0378 and b0379 split - and 4 started: b0378_1 / _2 and b0379_1 / _2. Every delta is the published rule set moving, as master's own bank of the same refresh records: Re-banked 2026-11-13 for the BoE banking taxonomy refresh v4.0.0 -> v4.1.1 (Basel 3.1 extract now basel31-boe-v4.1.1-credit-risk.json: 816 rules / 800 enforced, from 820 / 808; the CRR extract is byte-identical). Engine, fixtures and the 26-run matrix are UNCHANGED - only the published rule set moved - so every delta below is a rule-set change, read rule by rule (LESSONS C4) from a per-run, per-rule outcome dump taken under BOTH extracts on the same tree. union_binding_rules_b31 331 -> 325 (-6) = 10 lost, 4 gained. LOST: boe_b0744, boe_b0745, boe_b0752_22, boe_b0752_23, boe_b0752_24 (WITHDRAWN by the BoE - b0744 / b0752_22 / b0752_24 were registered 'limit of the published rule' breaks, and the four withdrawn b0752 members are exactly the averaged columns c0010/c0230/c0240/c0250 of the r0070 = sum(grades) family); boe_b0756, boe_b0757, boe_b0758 (rewritten to the per-grade paired form and marked not-in-XBRL, so no longer enforced); boe_b0378, boe_b0379 (SPLIT). GAINED: boe_b0378_1, boe_b0378_2, boe_b0379_1, boe_b0379_2 - the sign-aware split, whose _2 rules cover the '(-)' deduction columns and PASS on crm-substitution on 5 / 3 real coordinates where the unsplit rules failed. No rule present in both versions changed outcome on any run except boe_b0718 (NOT_EVALUATED throughout; reason row_not_emitted -> unsupported_grammar, now an If/then/else) and boe_b0735 (below). never_evaluated_rules 757 -> 756 (-1) = 3 left, 2 entered. LEFT: boe_b0303, boe_b0752_1 (withdrawn), boe_b0755 (not-in-XBRL). ENTERED: boe_b0751_1 (new WARNING on the OF 08.01 Total-IRB sheets z0001/z0002, which scope.py maps to no bundle key - a pre-existing never-emitted surface) and boe_b0735, whose v4.1.1 expression adds OF 08.03 r0170, the 100% default PD band, which NO run emits: the defaulted A-IRB leg IRC-LN-RRE-DEF carries pd = pd_floored = 0.006 and bands into r0060 - a pre-existing reporting defect, filed as P1.381 (boe_b0739 has been never-evaluated on the same row since v4.0.0). The B31 OF 08.01 r0010 decompositions lost their published guard with b0744/b0745 - filed as P2.60. union_binding_rules_crr, cells_live, template_cell_liveness_bp and dead_cells are unchanged. SUPERVISORY REGISTER re-measured with REGEN_VALIDATION_BASELINE=1, not hand-edited: known_broken_rules 27 -> 20 (the seven b31 entries boe_b0378, b0379, b0744, b0752_22, b0752_24, b0756, b0758 - every one a rule the BoE withdrew, split or took out of XBRL; none added) and known_vacuous_rules 189 -> 188 (boe_b0735 out, as above). (That bank was measured on master before the OF 08 sheet axis, which is why its numbers differ.) PREVIOUS BANK: Re-banked 2026-11-13 (seventh time), for the Basel 3.1 OF 08 sheets on the published 17-sheet axis with their two Totals. Four metrics improved: union_binding_rules_b31 365 -> 397, cells_live 9171 -> 10309, template_cell_liveness_bp 1483 -> 1600, never_evaluated_rules 721 -> 687 - the rules that address an OF 08 sheet by code had no sheet to read. ONE MOVED THE PERMISSIVE WAY AND IS BANKED DELIBERATELY: dead_cells 52668 -> 54142, the mechanical cost of new sheets (the same as the OF 07.00 Total): each Total declares a full grid and a cell no member sheet reports is empty on it by design. CRR and union_binding_rules_crr did not move. PREVIOUS BANK: Re-banked 2026-11-13 (sixth time), because the run matrix changed: 26 -> 28 runs, adding netting-mismatch under both regimes (tests/fixtures/reporting_netting_mismatch_portfolio.py). No metric moved, and that is the reason the portfolio was registered. The same change stops Basel 3.1 OF 07.00 deducting on-balance-sheet netting twice (escape log 2026-09-05); before it, OF 07.00 col 0130 was non-zero under Basel 3.1 only on the netting portfolio and only because of the double count, so the fix alone took boe_b0555 ({c0130} <= {c0140}) to vacuous on every run and union_binding_rules_b31 365 -> 364 (measured). netting-mismatch is the first portfolio with a Basel 3.1 SA exposure carrying genuine financial collateral beside a netted deposit, so boe_b0555 and boe_b0538 assert there and the metric holds at 365. PREVIOUS BANK: Re-banked 2026-11-13 (fifth time), for C 02.00 / OF 02.00 on the published row codes and cells (corep/c02_rows.py). Three metrics improved: union_binding_rules_crr 282 -> 286 (v0204_m, v0205_m, v0210_m, v0211_m - the EBA footing rules of C 02.00 could resolve no row before), union_binding_rules_b31 361 -> 365 (boe_b0716, boe_b0720, boe_b1092, boe_b1093), never_evaluated_rules 729 -> 721. THREE MOVED THE PERMISSIVE WAY AND ARE BANKED DELIBERATELY: cells_live 9262 -> 9171, template_cell_liveness_bp 1498 -> 1483, dead_cells 52583 -> 52668. Every address that changed state is on this one template, and each is accounted for: 95 are newly dead and 10 are no longer declared. Of the 95, 78 are Basel 3.1 addresses that are NOT cells of the published template - column 0020 on the SA rows and on row 0010, column 0030 on every row but 0010 and 0034-0036, columns 0010 / 0020 on the three floor rows - where a figure used to be reported and could not be filed; and 17 (11 Basel 3.1, 6 CRR) are published rows of the other risk types and of rows 0450 / 0470 that this calculator computes nothing for, now laid out at their published codes and left empty. The 10 no longer declared are rows 0430, 0440 and 0500, which neither template has in the form the layout gave them. No figure the template has a cell for stopped being reported. The harness now passes each run's own floor summary to the COREP generator, as production does, so the floor cells (row 0010 column 0030, rows 0034 and 0036) are measured as they are filed. PREVIOUS BANK: Re-banked 2026-11-13 (fourth time), an improvement on every metric that moved: cells_live 9232 -> 9262, template_cell_liveness_bp 1493 -> 1498, dead_cells 52613 -> 52583. Cause: equity and CIU holdings now carry their counterparty's country, so the C 09.01 / OF 09.01 country sheets report rows 0140-0143 and 0150 (they were on the all-countries sheet only). PREVIOUS BANK: Re-banked 2026-11-13 (third time), for the C 07.00 / OF 07.00 Total sheet (published sheet code 0001, Annex II para 47), which the generator now produces as the sum of the class sheets. Five metrics improved: union_binding_rules_crr 272 -> 282, union_binding_rules_b31 340 -> 361, cells_live 8336 -> 9232, template_cell_liveness_bp 1416 -> 1493, never_evaluated_rules 748 -> 729 - the rules scoped to sheet 0001 had no sheet to read. ONE MOVED THE PERMISSIVE WAY AND IS BANKED DELIBERATELY: dead_cells 50529 -> 52613. That is the mechanical cost of a new sheet, not a lost figure: the Total declares a full grid in every run that has a class sheet, and a cell no class reports is empty on it (and stays dead) by design - a sum over nothing is not a measured zero. Declared cells rose by 2,980, of which 896 are live. PREVIOUS BANK: Re-banked 2026-11-13 (second time): cells_live 8754 -> 8336, template_cell_liveness_bp 1462 -> 1416, dead_cells 51119 -> 50529. One cause, and it is a deliberate fall of the floor: the Basel 3.1 OF 07.00 layout reported a value in cells the published template does not have. PS1/26 Annex I greys out the CRM substitution block on the risk-weight rows, every column before the exposure value on the counterparty-credit-risk rows, col 0211 away from the netting-set and risk-weight rows and the ECAI breakdown on most of-which rows, and has no column 0020 at all; the Bank's taxonomy holds no data point for any of them. Those cells are now blank (corep/of07_published_cells.py, held exactly to the taxonomy by tests/contracts/test_of07_published_cells.py), so 418 addresses that some run used to put a value in are no longer live (over the reference outputs the same change blanks 447 cells: 403 that held a zero and 44 that held a figure). They were never coverage of the template: a value there could not be filed. Declared cells fell by 1,008 (column 0020, always null, is gone), which is why dead_cells fell although 418 blanked cells joined it. No rule count moved. PREVIOUS BANK: Re-banked 2026-11-13: union_binding_rules_b31 331 -> 340 and never_evaluated_rules 757 -> 748. One cause: the Basel 3.1 OF 09.02 layout carried its RWEA in column 0125 and had no column 0110, the reverse of the published template (PS1/26 Annex I: ... 0105, 0107, 0110, 0120, 0130), so the nine v4.0.0 rules that read OF 09.02 c0110 could resolve nothing and were never evaluated. With the RWEA in 0110 they bind. Two of the nine now break and are in validation_known_breaks.json with their reasons (boe_b0303, a rule the Bank withdrew in v4.1.1; boe_b0908, a Warning-severity plausibility check). No other metric moved.
